1.73 m2 
• Decrease in function, with 
kidneys starting to decline. 
• Client will have 
hypertension. 
• Client may have anemia, 
fatigue, anorexia, 
malnutrition, and bone 
pain. 
• Continue high 
water only if no 
edema or heart 
failure present. 
• If client has heart 
failure or edema, 
restrict fluids. 
• Continue with low-
fat and low-
sodium diet and 
food options that 
are high in calcium 
and magnesium. 
• If heart failure or 
edema is present, 
restrict foods with 
phosphorus, 
potassium, and 
protein, limiting 
proteins that are 
plant-based or 
from lean meats.
